title: Color Mixing Lab
shareTitle: Color Mixing Lab 🧪 — Field Journal Watercolor Experiments
description: Pour two painted glass flasks into a watercolor beaker and discover the new color in three experiments: discover, predict, and recipe. A hands-on color laboratory for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Observe cause and effect in primary-color mixing
Predict a color before testing the mixture
Recall which two colors make orange, green, and purple
interactionModel: Custom watercolor workbench: drag or tap-tap painted flasks into the padded beaker pour zone, with prediction cards in predict mode
feedbackModel: Accepted pours animate a flask, paint stream, beaker tint, and speaking result; non-requested choices wiggle or boop with a friendly spoken model and no loss state.
credits: Kaigani; Field Journal watercolor art and authored flask, beaker, stream, and mascot assets. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
